retrievalProfile.description: A top-down composition featuring multiple hands of varying skin tones resting on weathered, vertical wooden planks against a blue sky background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, top-down photograph of several hands with diverse skin tones gripping and resting upon a rustic, weathered wooden fence or structure, framed by a clear blue sky visible through the gaps, featuring distressed, textured typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Hands radiating from the edges toward a central wooden cross-section
Rough, splintered wood texture contrasting with smooth skin
Deep shadows under the hands creating a sense of depth
Distressed white and ochre text layered over the central wooden beam
coreInvariants: Weathered grey-brown wooden planks as the primary structural element
Top-down, slightly fish-eye or wide-angle perspective
Visible blue sky in the negative space between planks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Multiple hands enter from all four corners and sides, scaled to appear life-sized relative to the wooden frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horizontal wooden beam in the upper-middle third where the primary text is placed.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the arms from the edges toward the center, then settle on the textured typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The gaps between the vertical planks showing a bright blue sky.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earthy browns and greys from the weathered wood.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blues from the sky visible in the background gaps.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Ochre or mustard yellow used for the secondary subtitle text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with deep shadows and bright highlights on the skin; muted saturation in the wood.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serifs and distressed sans-serifs
letterConstructionRules: Irregular, eroded edges suggesting stamp or stencil application
Variable opacity within glyphs to simulate wear
Slightly uneven baseline for a raw, organic feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters have 'chipped' sections and internal texture
The 'O' characters are slightly irregular circles
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Two weights of the same distressed family, contrasting color and case (Upper vs Lower).
graphicDevices: Parental advisory label in bottom right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif structure with a weathered feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A top-down photo of multiple hands of different skin tones resting on a weathered grey wooden fence. Blue sky is visible through the gaps between the vertical planks. Add white decorative scrollwork in the top right and bottom left corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply distressed, stencil-style slab-serif text in the upper center. The top line should be white uppercase; the second line should be ochre-yellow lowercase, slightly smaller and aligned to the right of the first line.

verificationChecks: Check for weathered texture on all letterforms
Ensure blue sky is visible in background gaps
Verify hands are coming from multiple directions
Confirm ochre color for the subtitle

adjustableVariables: Color of the sky (e.g., sunset vs midday)

mustAchieve: Naturalistic lighting and shadows on hands

postGenerationChecks: Are the hands realistically integrated with the wood?
Is the text legible despite the heavy distressing?
Does the blue sky provide enough contrast for the composition?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [weathered structural element] + [multiple human points of contact] + [distressed stencil typography] + [high-contrast natural lighting].
